city.match: Match each museum to its city.
city.odd: Three of these museums are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Louvre Museum
rows.description: art and archeology museum in Paris, France
rows.hook: houses the Mona Lisa behind its glass pyramid entrance

rows.label: British Museum
rows.description: national museum in London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: displays the Rosetta Stone, the key that helped decode ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs

rows.label: Metropolitan Museum of Art
rows.description: art museum in New York City, United States
rows.hook: hosts the star-studded Met Gala fundraiser every spring

rows.label: Victoria and Albert Museum
rows.description: museum in London, England, United Kingdom
rows.hook: holds the world's largest collection of decorative arts and design

rows.label: Museum of Modern Art
rows.description: art museum in Manhattan in New York City, New York, United States
rows.hook: displays Van Gogh's swirling Starry Night

rows.label: Musée d'Orsay
rows.hook: fills a former train station with Impressionist masterpieces

rows.label: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
rows.description: art museum in New York, New York
rows.hook: spirals upward inside a landmark building designed by Frank Lloyd Wright

rows.label: American Museum of Natural History
rows.description: natural history museum in Manhattan, New York
rows.hook: greets visitors with towering dinosaur skeletons and a life-size model of a blue whale

rows.label: Uffizi Gallery
rows.description: palace and art museum in Florence, Italy
rows.hook: displays Botticelli's painting of Venus rising from a seashell

rows.label: Museo del Prado
rows.description: Spanish national art museum in Madrid, Spain
rows.hook: showcases royal portraits by Velazquez and dark visions by Goya

rows.label: Hermitage Museum
rows.hook: occupies the former winter palace of Russia's tsars

rows.label: Rijksmuseum
rows.hook: displays Rembrandt's dramatic militia scene The Night Watch
